name: Necropolis Native
body:
You have sneaked into a necropolis on multiple occasions to wander the dusty abandoned streets.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 trait bonus on saves against fear effects. In addition, your knowledge of the city grants you a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge (local) checks, and that skill is always a class skill for you.
